description:
Top-level tenant (R9.1).

Mirrors ``organization`` table. ``name`` is the unique stable
identifier; ``display_name`` is the human-friendly label surfaced
in the UI. We split the two so renaming for display does not
cascade into FK churn.

display_name.description: Human-readable organization name shown in the UI.
display_name.title: Display Name

name.description: Stable lowercase identifier (slug). Unique across the registry. Used in URLs and SNS topic names.
name.title: Name

title: Organization
